description: Source code for the SSB (Synchronization Signal Block) scheduler in a 5G NR (New Radio) system, implementing scheduling logic for different SSB patterns and slots based on 3GPP TS 38.213 specifications.

classes.name: ssb_scheduler
classes.description: Class responsible for scheduling SSBs in a 5G NR system, handling different pattern cases and slot allocations.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Schedules SSBs for a given slot, handling initial and subsequent slots.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Resets the scheduler to initial state.

methods.name: schedule_ssb
methods.description: Performs the actual scheduling of SSBs within a slot, based on pattern case.

methods.name: ssb_alloc_case_A_C
methods.description: Allocates SSBs for pattern cases A and C based on frequency and slot index.

methods.name: ssb_alloc_case_B
methods.description: Allocates SSBs for pattern case B based on slot index and frequency.

methods.name: ssb_alloc_case_D
methods.description: Allocates SSBs for pattern case D based on slot index within a 5ms burst.

methods.name: fill_ssb_parameters
methods.description: Fills in the SSB information structure with parameters for transmission.
